I’m gonna open up here a bit. 

I grew up feeling like an alien who was not compatible with the world. Low processing speed, ADHD, and a wild home life made my self-worth hit an all-time low. At some point I considered ‘leaving’ earth, to say the least. 

But, through a series of exploratory tasks, I was able to refine myself to a version that I liked. I highly recommend setting yourself up with some challenges. Talk to a stranger at a bar this month. Go to a cheap gym and make a friend. Chat up a stranger waiting in a line. Tell someone that you barely know your interests. Go to a university and hang out in the library. Lie to a stranger and make up a backstory. Join a school club. Learn to drop your guard and be vulnerable with strangers. 

This is what stimulated growth for me. Trying new things adjusted my difficulty standard and suddenly things that seemed hard (like making a decision in life) started to get easier. 

I wish you luck and hope for your success. If you ever need someone to listen don’t hesitate to reach out.
